description: This file is a CMake module script for locating and configuring the NVIDIA NCCL libraries within a build system. It sets variables, checks for library presence, and verifies version compatibility.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file (nccl.h) in given hints.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the NCCL library file (nccl or nccl_static) in specified hints.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard argument checks for package discovery success.

methods.name: check_cxx_symbol_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific C++ symbol (NCCL_VERSION_CODE) exists in the header.

methods.name: try_run
methods.description: Compiles and runs a small test program to verify NCCL version consistency.
